output.reason: On its own, the cited bullet [ev-5546e0710ba8] is just a metric name. But the section intro it sits under [ev-1f419676f177] says what the change is. In 3.0.0, the listed metrics that start with `cortex_` (this one included) change to start with `loki_`. That makes this a rename to `loki_prometheus_rule_group_duration_seconds_count`. Exposed environments are those that leave `metrics_namespace` at its new default `loki`. Setting it to `cortex` keeps the old name, but that setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. So anything that queries the old metric name stops matching unless the operator acts, which is enough to write subject, change, applicability and consequence.
